newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Soccer violence erupts in Indonesia; two hurt.
newsitem.headline: Soccer violence erupts in Indonesia; two hurt.

text.p: Soccer fans clashed in the Indonesian capital Jakarta after a tense semi-final of the national championship and at least two people were seriously injured, the Jakarta Post newspaper said on Saturday.
The newspaper said dozens of cars and buses were smashed after supporters of Mastrans Bandung Raya and Mitra Surabaya went on the rampage outside the central Jakarta stadium on Friday.
The team from Bandung -- on the main island of Java -- won the match 4-2 after a penalty shoot-out against their rivals from Surabaya, Indonesia's second-largest city.
The daily said that 1,200 security officers were unable to stop the violence after an ill-tempered match for a place in Sunday's final.
Kompas newspaper said four fans were questioned by police but there was no word of arrests.
